title: Derived quasi-coherent hyperdescent with negative Ext vanishing
statement: Use schemes [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Derived direct image is computed by K-injective resolutions, and derived tensor pullback by K-flat resolutions. Let $Z$ be an algebraic space over a scheme $S$, and $u:U_\bullet\to Z$ an fppf hypercover by algebraic spaces: an augmented simplicial object whose maps to the matching objects (the finite limits of compatible proper faces, with degree-zero matching object $Z$) are flat locally finitely presented surjective morphisms. Write $u_n:U_n\to Z$. (1) Suppose $K_n\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{U_n})$ are given with isomorphisms $Lh_\varphi^*K_m\simeq K_n$ for every simplicial structure map $h_\varphi:U_n\to U_m$, compatible with composition and identity under the canonical pullback comparisons. If $\operatorname{Hom}(K_n,K_n[i])=0$ for every $n\ge0$ and $i<0$, there exist $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ and compatible isomorphisms $Lu_n^*K\simeq K_n$. (2) If $M,N\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ satisfy $\operatorname{Hom}(Lu_n^*M,Lu_n^*N[i])=0$ for every $n\ge0$ and $i<0$, restriction gives a bijection between $\operatorname{Hom}(M,N)$ and maps $Lu_0^*M\to Lu_0^*N$ whose two pullbacks to $U_1$ agree. Also $\operatorname{Hom}(M,N[i])=0$ for $i<0$. Derived pullback along this covering detects zero objects and isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0DLA, lemma-fppf-glue-neg-ext-zero, and Tag 0DL9, lemma-fppf-neg-ext-zero-hom. The coherent family version implies the degree-zero/one hypothesis of 0DLA. Detection of isomorphisms is faithful flatness on cohomology.

proof.text: Retain only injective order maps. By [lem-sfb-hypercover-augmentation-face-property] every transition of this face diagram and every $u_n$ is flat, and the corresponding module pullbacks $f_\alpha^*$ and $u_n^*$ on small etale sites are exact. Form its ringed total category $\mathscr M$ and augmentation using [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category], on the diagram of enlarged etale sites fixed in [lem-sfb-fppf-face-total-qcoh-equivalence]. This avoids any assumption about degeneracies. In (1), the supplied isomorphisms restrict to a cartesian semisimplicial derived system. Its negative self Hom groups have exactly the vanishing hypothesis of [lem-sfb-flat-semisimplicial-derived-realization], which produces $B\in D(\mathscr M)$ realizing all the $K_n$.

source.place: 0DLA realization step, with the face-only correction to the flatness premise of 0D9T

proof.text: The object $B$ is cartesian and every component has quasi-coherent cohomology. Thus [lem-sfb-fppf-face-total-qcoh-equivalence] gives $B\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathscr M)$ and $K=Ru_*B$ with $Lu^*K\simeq B$. Evaluation gives isomorphisms $\lambda_n:Lu_n^*K\simeq K_n$ compatible with all faces. They also respect every degeneracy $s:U_n\to U_{n+1}$. Choose a face $d:U_{n+1}\to U_n$ with $ds=1$. Write $\theta_d:Ld^*K_n\simeq K_{n+1}$ and $\theta_s:Ls^*K_{n+1}\simeq K_n$ for the supplied structure maps. Face compatibility says $\lambda_{n+1}=\theta_d Ld^*\lambda_n$. Pulling this equality along $s$, then composing with $\theta_s$, yields $\theta_s Ls^*\lambda_{n+1}=\lambda_n$, because $\theta_s Ls^*\theta_d=1$. All equalities include the canonical composition comparisons. Every order map factors as a surjection followed by an injection, so this proves (1) for the entire supplied simplicial system.

source.place: 0DLA final descent step; explicit recovery of the degeneracy comparisons

proof.text: For (2), put $B=Lu^*M$, $C=Lu^*N$ on the face total site. By [lem-sfb-fppf-face-total-qcoh-equivalence], these are cartesian and $\operatorname{Hom}(M,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(B,C)$. Their evaluations are $Lu_n^*M$ and $Lu_n^*N$ by [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category]. The transition pullbacks are exact by [lem-sfb-hypercover-augmentation-face-property], and the assumed negative cross Hom vanishing therefore allows [lem-sfb-flat-semisimplicial-derived-hom] to identify $\operatorname{Hom}(B,C)$ with compatible component maps.

source.place: 0DL9, identification of global Hom with Hom on the total site and descent of compatible systems

proof.text: A compatible family is determined by its degree-zero map $v_0$, since any vertex injection $[0]\hookrightarrow[n]$ identifies both component objects with pullbacks of their degree-zero objects. Conversely suppose the two pullbacks of $v_0$ to $U_1$ agree, using the canonical identifications for $M,N$. Define $v_n$ by pulling $v_0$ along the last vertex. Pulling the equality on $U_1$ along each edge injection $[1]\hookrightarrow[n]$ shows that this is also the pullback along every other vertex. For any injection $\alpha:[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$, the chosen vertex of $[m]$ maps to one of these vertices, so the composition identities give $v_n\theta^B_\alpha=\theta^C_\alpha Lf_\alpha^*v_m$. Thus these families correspond exactly to the stated degree-zero equalizer, proving the bijection.

Fix $i<0$ and apply the component-map bijection of step 3 to $M,N[i]$. Its negative cross Hom hypothesis holds: for $t<0$, the component group is $\operatorname{Hom}(Lu_n^*M,Lu_n^*N[i+t])=0$ since $i+t<0$. Every degree-zero component of a global map $M\to N[i]$ is zero by the original hypothesis. Injectivity from [lem-sfb-flat-semisimplicial-derived-hom] then makes the global map zero. Hence $\operatorname{Hom}(M,N[i])=0$ for all $i<0$.

source.place: 0DL9(1), shifting the target and using injectivity

proof.text: Finally let $A\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ have zero pullback on every $U_n$. The exact evaluations in [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category] give $e_nH^q(Lu^*A)=H^q(Lu_n^*A)=0$ for all $n,q$. Joint conservativity makes each $H^q(Lu^*A)$ zero, so $Lu^*A=0$; the equivalence [lem-sfb-fppf-face-total-qcoh-equivalence] implies $A=0$. Applied to the cone of a morphism this detects isomorphisms, since derived pullback is triangulated and an arrow is an isomorphism exactly when its cone is zero. Already vanishing on $U_0$ suffices: each $u_n$ factors through $u_0$ by a vertex, so functoriality of derived pullback gives vanishing on all $U_n$.

source.place: 0DHF equivalence and component conservativity; detection needs no negative Ext assumption
